opening.argument: The warning signs are cumulative. The title says XRP's price “Has No Limit”; the speaker calls the news “extremely bullish” and urges viewers to stay for the whole video. He then imagines a valuation of hundreds of trillions, and the description offers a place to buy XRP. None of these statements alone proves a guaranteed payoff. Together, though, they press an exceptionally large upside case while putting a purchase route within reach. Judge the full presentation, not just the absence of the words “guaranteed return.”
